description: Defines command-line application classes for triggering handover and conditional handover in a 3GPP-related system, including parsing arguments and invoking mobility command handlers.

classes.name: handover_app_command
classes.description: Command class to trigger a UE handover with specified serving PCI, RNTI, and target PCI.

classes.name: cho_app_command
classes.description: Command class to trigger a conditional handover with multiple target PCIs, optional timeout, and T1 timestamp override.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments and triggers handover or conditional handover via the mobility command handler.
